The parallel cell reports actual parallel use, four subagents, finished process state, and aggregate quality of 211 passed tests out of 352.
The status record confirms mode parallel, enabled multi-agent execution, child thread activity, artifact packaging, and official evaluation failure at 211/352.
The official ProgramBench evaluation summary is completed and reports solution_passed false with 211 passed and 141 failing test statuses.
The final response describes a Python reimplementation and notes a material limitation: model files are not binary-format compatible with the original fastText files.

timeline_reviews.summary: The wrapper trajectory is transport-only and is accounted for by the manifest without projected semantic events.

The parent read docs, spawned three probe children, performed its own CLI probes, waited, interrupted the children, implemented a Python solution, ran local checks, and closed with a binary-format limitation.
The help-probe child read docs, probed usage/help behavior, attempted nested delegation that hit the thread limit, and was aborted before a returned result.
The prediction-probe child created temporary probe files, trained and queried small models, explored prediction/vector commands, and was interrupted before a parent-visible handoff.
The training-probe child explored training and quantize behavior, observed shared workspace provenance risk, moved to a unique probe directory, and was interrupted before completion.

direct_file_reviews.summary: The prompt is byte-identical to the parallel prompt and requires clean-room CLI-based reimplementation from the binary and bundled documentation.
The serial cell reports no parallel use, zero subagents, finished process state, and aggregate quality of 246 passed tests out of 352.
The status record confirms serial mode, disabled multi-agent execution, no child activity, artifact packaging, and official evaluation failure at 246/352.
The official ProgramBench evaluation summary is completed and reports solution_passed false with 246 passed and 106 failing test statuses.
The final response describes a fresh C++ reimplementation, a build entrypoint, and verified coverage of many observed CLI edge cases.

timeline_reviews.summary: The wrapper trajectory is transport-only and is accounted for by the manifest without projected semantic events.
The serial agent alone read docs, probed help/training/prediction/vector/error behavior, implemented a C++ replacement, compiled it, reran representative checks, and closed without delegation.

parallel.requirements: Recognized that the executable is a fastText-style CLI and that implementation must be original, based only on the provided binary and README.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Split probing among help, prediction, and training children while the parent also probed, then the parent became the implementation owner after child interruption.
parallel.implementation: Built a Python replacement in src/fasttext_reimpl.py with CLI parsing, model serialization, supervised and unsupervised behavior, vector commands, analogies, and quantize handling.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Added compile.sh to preserve the original binary as reference_executable and copy the Python script to executable; packaged numerous temporary probe artifacts as well.
parallel.verification: Ran py_compile, compile.sh, local command probes, training, prediction, test, vector, nn, analogies, quantize, and default-bucket checks against observed behavior.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Closed with an acknowledged material limitation that model files were not binary-format compatible with original fastText, and official evaluation failed 211/352.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same fastText clean-room CLI requirement and avoided source lookup or binary analysis beyond normal command interaction.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Kept probing, implementation, build, and verification under one serial owner with no child agents or handoff lifecycle.
serial.implementation: Built a C++ replacement in src/main.cpp with command dispatch, option parsing, model persistence, supervised/unsupervised commands, prediction/test utilities, dump, vectors, nn, analogies, and quantize behavior.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Added compile.sh, compiled a native executable into the workspace, adjusted the script to be checkout-relative, and delivered source plus executable.
serial.verification: Ran representative original-binary probes first, then compiled and checked usage, training, prediction/test, dump, vectors, nn, analogies, missing-file, quantize, and build behavior.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Still failed official evaluation at 246/352, with residual risk around exact training numerics and broad semantic edge cases.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel identified a fastText-style clean-room CLI reimplementation and covered many commands, but its final answer acknowledged model binary compatibility was missing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial identified the same task and covered the observed command surface, error routing, model save/load, and training/prediction behavior in a C++ implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The recognized requirements were broadly similar, but serial converted more probing into delivered behavior and scored higher; parallel left a visible model-compatibility limitation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split initial probing into three child agents while the parent also probed, then interrupted the children and owned implementation alone.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no delegation and carried all probing, implementation, and verification in one continuous owner path.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced child ownership for probe areas but did not receive finished child outputs; serial avoided handoff and child lifecycle overhead.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs are encrypted in the ledger, so missing brief details cannot be proven; observable context transfer failed because children were interrupted before handoff.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial retained its own probes and implementation context locally without cross-agent contracts or child result handoffs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The contrast is not a proven missing-requirement brief; it is that parallel created a result boundary and then cut it off, while serial kept context local.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel implemented a Python script copied to executable by compile.sh, with lazy bucket-backed model storage and a self-consistent but non-original-compatible model format.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial implemented a native C++ program compiled by g++, with command parser, model storage, vector functions, test/predict commands, and observed edge-case handling.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The implementation language and model format differed materially; serial's C++ path aligned better with the binary surface and scored higher.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children remained running through waits, were interrupted, and did not return usable final probe syntheses to the parent.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to retrieve and directly carried local command observations into implementation and verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The key lifecycle difference is lost child result availability in parallel versus continuous local state in serial.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children wrote probe files in shared workspace areas; one child observed active concurrent workspace activity and moved to a unique artifact directory.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used a single temporary workspace owner, then wrote source and compile outputs without concurrent actors.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a concrete shared-workspace provenance problem among live children; serial did not.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran local probes and checks after its Python implementation, but did not close the model-format compatibility gap before final response.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial reran representative probes after compiling, including edge cases such as test with stdin, analogies behavior, dump, prediction thresholds, and missing-file errors.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial's verification set was broader and more directly tied to observed edge cases, though still insufficient for an official pass.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used four subagents and substantial tool activity, but ended before timeout with children interrupted and a known limitation still present.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used more wall time in one owner path, compiled late in the run, performed final checks, and ended before timeout with residual numeric risk.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent budget on child probes that were not harvested; serial spent budget on sequential probing and C++ refinement that yielded a higher partial score.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both official evaluations failed, so there is no discordant pass/fail outcome. The serial run nevertheless scored higher because its single-owner C++ implementation incorporated a broader set of observed CLI and edge-case behavior, while the parallel run lost delegated probe work through interruption and closed with an admitted model-format incompatibility.
parallel_contributors: Interrupted child probes produced no usable returned synthesis for the parent before implementation.
The final Python implementation acknowledged lack of binary-format compatibility with original fastText model files.
serial_contributors: Serial retained one continuous probe-implementation-verification context and built a native C++ replacement.
Serial explicitly verified more edge cases, including stdin test behavior, analogies EOF behavior, dump output, and error cases.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Python self-consistent model serialization in parallel versus C++ model serialization and CLI behavior in serial.
Both implementations likely missed exact training numerics and broader evaluator edge cases.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; supported comparative contributors to the quality gap, not an exclusive root cause

There were no separately completed component implementations needing an unowned integration step.

The parent owned the implementation, build, local verification, and delivery pipeline, even though the result was incomplete.
No single mandatory serial preflight blocked all productive work; the parent and children probed concurrently from the start.

The parent retained and executed the critical implementation path; the child loss is better classified as explicit early termination.
The run did not exhaust wall-clock budget through excessive fan-out; it ended normally after explicit child interrupts.
The child scopes were probe categories, not a demonstrably overbroad indispensable assignment; interruption is the direct boundary.

The delegated work was probing rather than interoperating components, so no missing cross-agent file, namespace, input, or output contract is evidenced.
No completed child handoff lost known information in transfer; the visible issue is that children were interrupted before handoff.
No large returned handoff reached the parent and went unconsumed within the decision window.
No receiver consumed a handoff describing superseded workspace or requirement state.
No incompatible completed reports or contracts were returned to the parent and left unadjudicated.
The parent did not hide the visible unresolved gap; final.txt explicitly disclosed the model-format incompatibility limitation.
There is no replacement or retry child that repeated prior work without inherited checkpoints.

candidates.realized_consequence: All delegated probe threads were interrupted before the parent received a usable returned synthesis, leaving the parent to implement from its own narrower probe set.
candidates.near_match_reason: The parent did resume the work locally; the direct failure boundary is premature interruption of active children before result finalization.
